_id.description: Unique identifier of the document. Pattern: <billOfProcessStepId>-PP<nnn>

recordNo.description: Business identifier of the document, readable by people and unique within the site

siteId.description: Reference to u_mes_mdm_site._id: the site the document belongs to

siteName.description: Display value of the site, copied from u_mes_mdm_site.name

billOfProcessStepId.description: Reference to u_mes_prd_billOfProcessStep._id: the parent document this one belongs to

billOfProcessStepName.description: Display value of billOfProcessStepId, copied from u_mes_prd_billOfProcessStep.recordNo

sequenceNo.description: Position of this document in its list (within the same parent for child collections), starting at 1

name.description: Name of the bill of process step process parameter; used as its display value in other collections

nominal.description: Nominal of the bill of process step process parameter

unitOfMeasureName.description: Display value of unitOfMeasureId, copied from u_mes_mdm_unitOfMeasure.name

schemaVersion.description: Version of this collection's document structure, starting at 1
